issues.description: The method compares and subtracts using maxBlobGasPerBlock (786432) instead of targetBlobGasPerBlock (393216). The spec requires comparison and subtraction against TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK. This doubles the threshold at which excess starts accumulating.
issues.potential_impact: Consensus failure against spec-compliant clients; excess_blob_gas stays at 0 for usage between target and max, keeping blob base fee at MIN_BASE_FEE_PER_BLOB_GAS (1) when it should rise exponentially. Allows over-target blocks without fee pressure, enabling cheap blob spam and chain split.
issues.spec_reference: def calc_excess_blob_gas(parent: Header) -> int: if parent.excess_blob_gas + parent.blob_gas_used < TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK: return 0 else: return parent.excess_blob_gas + parent.blob_gas_used - TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK
issues.suggestion: Replace maxBlobGasPerBlock with targetBlobGasPerBlock (getTargetBlobGasPerBlock()) in both the comparison and subtraction: if (currentExcessBlobGas < targetBlobGasPerBlock) return 0; return currentExcessBlobGas - targetBlobGasPerBlock;

verification.matched_excerpt: def calc_excess_blob_gas(parent: Header) -> int: if parent.excess_blob_gas + parent.blob_gas_used < TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK: return 0 else: return parent.excess_blob_gas + parent.blob_gas_used - TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK

summary: The calculator correctly wires target/max blob gas values but computeExcessBlobGas violates EIP-4844 by using MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK instead of TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK. This single deviation breaks blob base-fee calculation and causes consensus divergence.
